instruction.text: The year is 1948. Fill in the gaps in this conversation.

atoms.b: I’ve come home from fighting in ((++World_War_2 Sunday_football)), but Britain is in ruins!
Don’t worry! I, Clement Attlee, ((++Prime_Minister prankster)) of the UK, have a plan!
We have passed a ((++law saw)) to give people in the Commonwealth British ((++citizenship cinnamon)).

hint.label: The Commonwealth
hint.text: The Commonwealth are the former British colonies.

atoms.b: That’s an important change, but how does it help us? We need ((++workers waiters)) to rebuild the country!
We will put up ((++adverts actors)) in the Caribbean telling them to come to Britain for work!
Amazing! Once their ((++ships space_shuttles)) arrive, they will be very important in rebuilding Britain!

atoms.a: After World War 2, Britain was in ruins.
A law was passed to give money to British citizens.
The UK government put up job adverts in the Caribbean.
